newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - CompUSA started as hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CompUSA started as hold.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth Inc on Friday initiated coverage of CompUSA Inc with a hold rating and an estimate of fiscal 1997 earnings of $0.90 per share. Dain estimated fiscal 1998 earnings of $1.10 per share.

-- Dain analyst Dean Ramos said CompUSA has been able to produce "standout results in what has become a treacherous sector for nearly all other participants." He cited the company's high per-store sales, estimated at $38 million, and its higher profit margins.
-- Ramos said CompUSA, the nation's largest retailer of personal computer products, was expected to continue to grow at a rapid pace, opening 29 stores this year.
-- The stock closed down 3/4 Friday at 20-7/8 in trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
